description: The daily regime (trend) rule relayed to Cryptohopper: long while the Coinbase daily close is more than one 20-day sigma above its 50-day average, flat once more than one below. Without a coin: the board for every coin; with a coin: its call, distance, days in state and the close that would change it.

coin.description: Coin ticker or name as on the site, for example BTC, ETH or SOL
